sentences.en: Sami asked to speak with Layla privately in his office.
sentences.zh: 萨米要求在自己的办公室里私下与莱拉谈话。

sentences.en: Is there somewhere that we can talk privately about this?
sentences.zh: 我们能找个地方私下谈谈这件事吗？

sentences.en: He contrived a means of speaking to Nancy privately.
sentences.zh: 他设法找机会单独和南希说话。
